headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP revenue across Active Electrical Cables, Optical DSPs, SiPho PICs, and IP Licensing.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): Credo generated $479.00M in Q1 FY27 (+114.7% YoY, +9.6% QoQ). Management guided Q2 FY27 revenue to $525M–$535M ($530M midpoint); Yahoo consensus sits at $531.95M (+98.5% YoY) while buy-side whispers target $542M–$550M+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share excluding $87.98M stock-based compensation and acquisition intangibles.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS ($/sh): Consensus is $1.28/sh (+91% YoY vs $0.67 in Q2 FY26, and +6.7% QoQ vs $1.20 in Q1 FY27) on ~200M guided diluted shares. Credo has beaten consensus EPS 4 consecutive quarters (+15.96% avg surprise).

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Non-GAAP product and IP gross margin excluding SBC and acquired intangible amortization.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Gross Margin (%): Posted 68.0% in Q1 FY27 (64.5% GAAP). Management guided Q2 FY27 Non-GAAP GM to 67.0%–69.0% despite integrating DustPhotonics silicon photonics PICs and ramping new 1.6T optical/AEC SKUs.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Optical Portfolio Run-Rate (DSPs, ZeroFlap & SiPho PICs)
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Combined revenue trajectory across Optical DSPs (50G/100G/1.6T), ZeroFlap optics, and DustPhotonics SiPho PICs.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Optical Portfolio Trajectory: Management targets >$600M in FY27 optical revenue (with ZeroFlap, SiPho PICs, and Optical DSPs each exceeding $100M) to diversify away from copper AEC concentration and drive fiscal H2 re-acceleration.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Balance sheet inventory staging ($313.05M) and US/APAC hyperscaler shipment concentration.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Inventory & Hyperscaler Mix: Inventory climbed +24.8% QoQ to $313.05M (+168% YoY) to support unfulfilled AEC and 1.6T backlog, while US shipments hit $255.44M (53.3%) and Malaysia surged 11x YoY to $74.46M.
